requirements.title: Machine-readable conformance evidence gates
Executable token transitions for an explicitly admitted BPMN subset
requirements.notes: The executable subset includes Standard Loops, FixedMultiInstance/1, and CollectionMultiInstance/1 on generic Tasks. Both Multi-Instance profiles freeze one bounded closed member set at activation, preserve stable index identity, run sequentially or in parallel with behavior All, and either join all members or, when an admitted completionCondition first becomes true, terminate the already generated active remainder and mark a sequential planned suffix not-generated. The collection profile preserves source order and duplicates, makes input-item mapping explicit, and admits only complete-success output gathering in source-index order. SubProcess and CallActivity multi-instance execution, progressive behavior events, partial collection output, and open or draining groups remain outside this kernel subset.

requirements.title: FixedMultiInstance/1 bounded generic Task execution
requirements.notes: This atomic executable profile is restricted to one generic Task with a version-bound formal loopCardinality, behavior absent or All, sequential or parallel execution, an optional version-bound formal completionCondition, and a compiled maximum cardinality. Cardinality is evaluated once before member creation. Durable group/member state records stable index and item identity, exact active/completed/terminated counters over generated instances, first-true completion cancellation, a distinct not-generated sequential suffix, Boundary Error or failure cleanup, late-completion fencing, and causal journal replay. XML v5 can represent broader collection and One/None/Complex metadata, but this cardinality profile does not silently adopt it; collection scatter/gather is covered only by the separate CollectionMultiInstance/1 requirement. It does not claim SubProcess or CallActivity multi-instance execution, progressive behavior events, open WCP15 groups, draining WCP34/WCP36 joins, or a complete BPMN Activity lifecycle.

requirements.title: CollectionMultiInstance/1 bounded collection-driven generic Task execution
requirements.notes: This atomic executable profile is restricted to one generic Task whose exact externally compiled binding for loopDataInputRef evaluates once at activation to a bounded canonical JSON array. Membership, source indices, order, and duplicate values are frozen before expansion; empty input creates no work. A scalar inputDataItem explicitly opts into current-item mapping, and absence forbids implicit injection. Complete output gathering requires loopDataOutputRef, a scalar outputDataItem, a matching collection-valued Task DataOutput, and a protocol-v3 Task binding; every member output is codec-validated and gathered by source index, with empty input yielding an empty output array. Output gathering with completionCondition is rejected until a partial-result policy is selected. Data documents, expression and collection bindings, Task bindings, and byte/cardinality limits are fingerprinted external compile inputs rather than semantics inferred from BPMN XML alone. Parallel all-join execution supplies the bounded WCP14 runtime-known case. This does not claim progressive behavior, externalized or streaming item manifests, SubProcess or CallActivity multi-instance execution, open WCP15 creation, WCP34/WCP36, a mandatory Effect Workflow backend, or complete BPMN Process Execution Conformance.

requirements.title: Protocol-bound Task outcomes and interrupting Boundary Error execution slice
requirements.notes: This atomic slice admits an immutable protocol-v3 binding on a generic Task, one-execution translation from a native managed-retry result, exact application-failure-to-BPMN-Error promotion, and at most one interrupting Boundary Error. The XML executable facade accepts task bindings explicitly through CompileXmlOptions and commits them to the executable fingerprint; bindings remain external executable inputs and are not inferred from BPMN XML. Schedule-to-close timeout remains operational and is not treated as a BPMN Error or Boundary Timer. This is not evidence for the complete Activity lifecycle, generic event propagation, BPMN Cancel, timers, non-interrupting boundaries, or event subprocesses.

requirements.title: Executable intersection of the named core-process XML profile and token kernel
requirements.notes: This is a deliberately narrower executable admission profile, not Process Execution Conformance. Profile bpmn-2.0.2-core-process-di-v5 admits while-style pre-test and BPMN post-tested Standard Loops plus FixedMultiInstance/1 and CollectionMultiInstance/1 only on generic Tasks. FixedMultiInstance/1 requires a version-bound loopCardinality. CollectionMultiInstance/1 requires exact external data and collection bindings, freezes one bounded array at activation, preserves indices/order/duplicates, exposes items only through scalar inputDataItem, and optionally gathers a complete codec-validated output array through loopDataOutputRef plus scalar outputDataItem. Both support sequential or parallel behavior All; completionCondition is admitted only without collection output. Unsupported process, gateway, event, activity, combined-loop, SubProcess-loop, progressive behavior, partial output, open-group, and implicit-activation semantics are rejected rather than inferred.

source.section: tDefinitions, tProcess, tActivity, tStandardLoopCharacteristics, tMultiInstanceLoopCharacteristics, flow nodes, and tSequenceFlow

requirements.notes: Profile bpmn-2.0.2-core-process-di-v5 covers ordinary processes and recursive subprocesses, generic tasks, source-level callActivity callable-element QNames, none start/end events, exclusive/parallel gateways, sequence flows, conditions, defaults, definitions metadata, explicit expression-version bindings, Standard Loop characteristics, and the represented tMultiInstanceLoopCharacteristics fields on generic Tasks. Multi-instance XML can round-trip cardinality, collection references, scalar inputDataItem/outputDataItem declarations with namespace-expanded itemSubjectRef QNames and xsd:string names including the empty string, sequential/parallel mode, completionCondition, behavior, and One/None event references in BPMN XSD order. Data-item IDs participate in global XML-ID validation, absent isCollection materializes false, and unrepresented children fail closed; complexBehaviorDefinition remains outside the slice. Executable collection semantics additionally require fingerprinted external bindings and declarations. Call activities are interchange-only until immutable child-target resolution and durable parent/child execution exist. This is a fail-closed implementation slice, not an OMG conformance subclass, complete semantic mapping, or general multi-instance profile.

WCP13 Multiple Instances with a Priori Design-Time Knowledge - fixed Task subset
requirements.notes: FixedMultiInstance/1 covers WCP13 only when the pinned cardinality expression represents a fixed design-time model value: parallel mode creates the closed set of independent, stably identified members and produces one continuation only after every member has completed. Sequential mode is supported by the BPMN profile but is not used as evidence for the pattern's concurrent form. The same runtime primitive instead admits WCP14 when the expression obtains its value from activation data.

requirements.title: WCP14 Multiple Instances with a Priori Run-Time Knowledge - frozen Task subset
requirements.notes: FixedMultiInstance/1 evaluates one runtime cardinality before creating any member. CollectionMultiInstance/1 instead snapshots one bounded collection with stable source indices, order, and duplicates before expansion. Both freeze a closed member set and join all members before one continuation; parallel mode is the WCP14 evidence and sequential mode is an additional BPMN execution form. Neither admits new members after activation, so WCP15 is not claimed.

requirements.title: WCP35 Cancelling Partial Join for Multiple Instances - completionCondition subset
requirements.notes: The admitted WCP35 evidence is the parallel closed-group subset. A pinned BPMN completionCondition is evaluated after every committed logical member completion. The first true result produces one continuation and terminates every already generated active remainder; a sequential planned suffix is never generated or counted as terminated. FixedMultiInstance/1 and CollectionMultiInstance/1 both admit this behavior, but the collection profile rejects output gathering in the same group until an explicit partial-result policy exists. This does not claim WCP15 open creation, WCP34 remainder draining, or WCP36 dynamic creation/draining. Those require a separate OpenForEachGroup/1 profile.

requirements.title: WCP21 Structured Loop - bounded generic Task subset
requirements.notes: This atomic requirement is scoped to executable while-style pre-test and BPMN post-tested behavior for one generic Task, with durable iteration identity, exact condition evidence whose true result means continue, and a mandatory positive iteration cap. It does not claim WCP21's combined pre/post-test variant, Standard Loops on SubProcesses, arbitrary cycles, or any multi-instance pattern. BPMN 2.0.2 section 13.3.6 explicitly maps Structured Loop to WCP-21; section 10.3.8 and Table 10.28 define the Standard Loop condition, testBefore default, and loopMaximum cap.
